name: io.github.Anioko/archiet-xray
description: Deterministic repo architecture maps: auth coverage, blast radius, readiness score, diagrams

packageArguments.description: Path to the repository to analyze (default: current directory)

tools.name: xray_scan
tools.description: Scan the repository and build the architecture model (routes, entities, tasks, module dependency graph, findings).

tools.name: arch_summary
tools.description: Compact architecture summary: modules, route prefixes, domain entities, hotspots, visibility score.

tools.name: blast_radius
tools.description: Given a file or module path, report what depends on it (fan-in), what it depends on (fan-out), and the routes/entities it contains.

tools.name: boundary_findings
tools.description: Deterministic risk findings: hardcoded secrets, raw SQL bypassing the ORM, auth tokens in localStorage, routes without auth guards.

tools.name: production_readiness
tools.description: Deterministic 0-100 production-readiness score across 8 dimensions with per-dimension evidence and top fixes.

tools.name: generate_diagrams
tools.description: Mermaid module dependency graph, ER/domain-model diagram, and HTTP route map extracted from the code, plus an HTML viewer.
